appointment_status.description: Whether a public source confirms the triggering leader's current title and start date. Verified = title and start month both sourced. Year only = title sourced, start year only. Not verified = no public source.

appointment_start.description: Start date of the triggering leader in the current role, as YYYY-MM or YYYY. NOT_FOUND if no source states it. Never infer from profile edit dates.

appointment_source_url.description: URL of the source that states the leader's current title and start date. NOT_FOUND if none.

signal_rationale.description: Two to three plain sentences on why this appointment is a buying signal for Eightfold, tied to the leader's stated scope (headcount covered, mandate, programs owned).

work_history_summary.description: The leader's last two roles before this one, with employer and dates, showing the current role is new. One line each.

workforce_context.description: Workforce events at the account in the last 12 months: hiring volume and mix, reorganizations, M&A, spin-offs, layoffs, reskilling or internal mobility programs. One line each with date and source URL.

hr_tech_stack.description: Publicly evidenced HRIS, ATS, recruiting CRM and talent intelligence vendors, each with a source URL. Name any Eightfold competitor in place (Phenom, Beamery, Gloat, SeekOut, HiredScore, Paradox). NOT_FOUND per category when unsourced.

eightfold_relationship.description: Whether public evidence shows the account already works with Eightfold AI (case study, press release, job posting naming Eightfold).

entry_point.description: The Eightfold product area most likely to land first at this account, given the leader's scope and the workforce context.

first_contact.description: Name and title of the contact to approach first, chosen from the account's audience contacts, with a one-line reason.

opener.description: A two-sentence opening message to the first contact. Reference the appointment and one sourced account fact. No flattery and no claim without a source.

open_risks.description: What could not be verified, stale contact data (for example an email at a previous employer), and any reason the account may fail the ICP or seniority gate.
